purpose: Role and handoff contract for reviewable 2D art production

responsibilities: normalize the deliverable and production constraints
turn author intent into a proposed or accepted Style Contract
never accept an Illusion proposal without author confirmation
generate or edit raster artifacts from an accepted contract
return artifact identity and observable generation metadata
avoid silently changing the accepted style contract
check deterministic format and style-contract gates
separate structural pass from subjective author approval
own style intent and reference authority
accept, revise, or reject style proposals and visual checkpoints

invariants: every generated or edited artifact is a new visible checkpoint
validation never becomes a hidden repainting channel
unknown reference rights are preserved as unknown
